name: camayoc_gp_trajectories_for_topic
description: golden-paths Q2: trajectories whose work item is about a topic, with each work item's close disposition. Absence of outcome means open.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?trajectory ?workitem ?outcome WHERE { ?trajectory a aegis:Trajectory ; aegis:trajectoryOf ?workitem . ?workitem aegis:about "{topic}" . OPTIONAL { ?workitem aegis:outcome ?outcome } } ORDER BY ?workitem

params.name: topic
params.description: topic parameter for this stored query.
